COSMIC BORDELLO: A Galactic Carnival of Love

Σάββατο 14 Φεβρουαρίου στις 20:00 | Bios Ρομάντσο

Romantso's basement transforms under lights that never quite reveal everything. Tonight the printing house gone cultural center becomes something else entirely — a cosmic bordello where carnival season and club culture collide in deliberate disorientation. The stairs descend toward sound and mystery.

COSMIC BORDELLO: A Galactic Carnival of Love treats Valentine's Day and Apokries as the same festival wearing different masks. The programming runs toward the ecstatic end of electronic music, the kind of selection that serves the costume rather than the everyday. Expect visual elements, performance moments, the theatrical excess that carnival demands.

The crowd here arrives in character. Carnival costume meets club wear, cosmic themes interpreted through sequins and intention. You'll find people who planned their outfits for weeks alongside those who assembled something on the way over. The masks and makeup create permission — to move differently, to interact differently, to let the night become its own planet for a few hours.

Romantso's basement has the bones for this kind of transformation. The low ceilings and concrete surfaces become stage, become setting, become part of the performance. What the room lacks in polish it makes up in possibility.

If you need your Valentine's romantic in the traditional sense, if you want straightforward club night without theatrical intervention, Cosmic Bordello operates in different orbit. This is carnival logic applied to the dancefloor — excess as expression, costume as communication. But if you've been looking for the moment when Athens underground throws its annual masked ball, where electronic music serves the transformation — you descend into the galaxy.
